title: प्रहरी बढुवाका रोचक मामिला- भावी आईजीका यस्ता हिसाब, सिनियर पत्नीलाई जुनियर पतिले जित्लान् त ?
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । अब एक महिनाभित्र नेपाल प्रहरीमा बढुवाको रस्साकस्सी शुरु हुँदैछ । त्यसक्रममा एउटै ब्याच दुई आईजी हुनेदेखि सिनियर पत्नीलाई जुनियर पतिले उछिन्नेसम्मका सन्दर्भ प्रहरीभित्र चर्चामा छ । प्रहरी महानिरीक्षकबाट दानबहादुर कार्की प्रधानमन्त्रीको सुरक्षा सल्लाहकारमा सरुवा र डा.मनोजकुमार केसी उक्त पदमा नियुक्त भएसँगै नेपाल प्रहरीमा एउटा एआईजी पद रिक्त भइसकेको छ । पुस ५ गते थप पाँच एआईजी अवकाशपछि रिक्त एआईजीको संख्या ६ पुग्दैछ । प्रहरी संगठनको सर्वोच्च पद महानिरीक्षक (आईजीपी) का भावी दाबेदार निर्धारण हुने गरी एआईजी बढुवाको तयारीमा सरकार जुटेको छ । २०८४ चैत १८ सम्म पदावधि कायम रहेका वर्तमान आईजीपी डा.केसी र उनको ब्याच १११ औँ टोलीका अधिकृत एकै साथ अवकाश हुँदा संगठनको नेतृत्व गर्नका निम्ति ११२ औँ टोलीबाट नयाँ आईजीपी चयन हुन्छन् । २०८२ कात्तिक १७ गतेको डीआईजी बढुवाको वरिष्ठता कायमै भएमा उक्त व्याचबाट भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री र सानुराम भट्टराई पुस ५ पछि एआईजीका दाबेदार हुन् । तर, उनीहरूसँगै १११ औँ टोलीबाट एआईजी हुन बाँकी रहेका चारजना डीआईजीले पुस ५ पछि रिक्त हुने एआईजी बढुवामा मौका पाउँदैछन् । त्यस्ता डीआईजीमा राजेन्द्रप्रसाद भट्ट, दिनेशकुमार आचार्य, अरुण पौडेल, गोविन्द थपलिया, सुदर्शनप्रसाद कोइराला र दीपक रेग्मी पर्छन् । उनीहरू २०८१ पुसमा एसएसपीबाट डीआईजीमा बढुवा भएका थिए । ११२ औँ टोलीका डीआईजीमध्ये खत्री र भट्टराईपछि बढुवाको वरिष्ठतामा क्रमशः ओमप्रसाद अधिकारी, शेखर खनाल, अविनारायण काफ्ले र विश्व अधिकारी छन् । यसमध्ये काफ्लेले यसपटक एआईजी पदको रिक्ततापछि बढुवा पाएनन् भने डीआईजीबाटै अवकाश हुनुपर्ने सम्भावना छ । उनी ३० वर्षे सेवा अवधिका कारण २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् । एआईजी बढुवा छनौटमुखी हुने हो भने भावी नेतृत्वमा अगाडि बढाइने दीपेन्द्रबहादुर घर्ती क्षेत्री, उनीपछि भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री, सानुराम भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । तर, १११ औँ टोलीलाई मात्रै प्राथमिकता दिइयो भने न घर्ती, न त खत्री र भट्टराई नै अहिले एआईजी हुन्छन् । त्यसैले सरकारले करिअरलाई हेर्छ कि पूर्वबढुवाको वरिष्ठता ? यो प्रतीक्षाको विषय हो । यदि एआईजीको लाइनमा राखियो भने हालका आईजीपी डा.केसीपछि ४५ दिनका लागि घर्ती र उनीपछि खत्री, भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । यदि घर्ती आईजीपी बनाइएनन् भने एउटै कारणले नबन्न सक्छन्, ‘नमस्ते टोली’ का नाममा । प्रहरीभित्र ‘नमस्ते’ भनिने राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट समायोजन भएका अधिकृतप्रति नकारात्मक व्यहार हुँदै आएको छ । घर्ती २०५५ जेठ १० मा सोही विभागमा भर्ना भएका थिए । यद्यपि, ११२ औँ टोलीबाट दुई जना एआईजी पाउने कि नपाउने भन्ने कुरा हाल सर्वोच्च अदालतमा निवर्तमान आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्कीले दायर गरेको रिटमाथिको आदेशमा निर्भर रहन्छ । कार्कीले आफूलाई पदबाट हटाइएको निर्णय बदर गर्ने मागसहित सर्वोच्च अदालतमा रिट दायर गरेका हुन् । यदि कार्की पदमा फर्किए भने एआईजीको रिक्त संख्या ५ मात्रै हुन्छ । पुस ५ गते राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट सेवा प्रवेश गरेका ५ एआईजी अवकाश हुन लागेका हुन् । अवकाश हुनेमा सिद्धीविक्रम शाह, सुशीलसिंह राठौर, माधवप्रसाद श्रेष्ठ, डम्बरबहादुर विक र उमाप्रसाद चतुर्वेदी छन् । उनीहरू २०५३ पुस ५ मा भर्ना भएका थिए । अनुसन्धान विभागका वर्तमान प्रमुख टेकेन्द्र कार्की पनि सोही भर्ना मितिका अधिकृत हुन् । सोही भर्ना मिति भए पनि उमेर हदका कारण प्रहरीका डीआईजी विनोदकुमार घिमिरे मंसिरमै अवकाश हुँदैछन् । त्यससँगै पुस ५ सम्ममा ६ जना डीआईजी अवकाश हुन्छन् । अवकाश हुने डीआईजीमा ओमबहादुर राना मगर, सुरेन्द्रबहादुर गुरुङ, हिमालयकुमार श्रेष्ठ, विमल बस्नेत र दिलीपसिंह देउवा हुन् । यसरी ६ जना डीआईजीको अवकाशपछि हुने डीआईजी बढुवाका निम्ति आठजना प्रतिस्पर्धी छन् । २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार डीआईजी हुने पहिलो नम्बरमा सोमेन्द्रसिंह राठौर छन् । उक्त एसएसपी बढुवाका १ देखि ६ नम्बरसम्मका एसएसपी डीआईजी भइसकेका छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार अब क्रमशः राठौरसहित मुकुन्द मरासिनी, दीपशम्शेर जबरा, गोपाल चन्द्र भट्टराई, प्रवीण पोखरेल, गंगा पन्त, कृष्णबहादुर पल्ली मगर, तारादेवी थापा र प्रज्वल मर्हजन डीआईजीका दाबेदार हुन् । एक ब्याच, दुई आईजीको सम्भावना टर्‍यो नेपाल प्रहरीमा एक व्याचबाट दुई आईजीको इतिहास रच्ने मौका ११२ औँ टोलीले पनि पाउने थियो । तर, नियुक्तिपत्र प्राप्त मितिलाई अदालतमार्फत संशोधन गराएपछि त्यस्तो सम्भावना टरेको छ । हाल आईजीको जिम्मेवारी पाएका डा.मनोजकुमार केसीअघि सोही ब्याचका दानबहादुर कार्की आईजी भइसकेका छन् । सोही ब्याचका अधिकृत नारायणदत्त पौडेल सशस्त्र आईजीपी छन् । ११२ औँ टोलीबाट अहिले एआईजी बढुवामा डीआईजी बढुवाको वरिष्ठता कायम हुँदा क्रमशः भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री र सानुराम भट्टराई क्रमशः ३५ औँ र ३६ औँ आईजीपी बन्ने सम्भावना थियो । उनीहरू एउटै मितिको सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका, तर नियुक्तिपत्रका आधारमा फरक मिति भएका अधिकृत हुन् । खत्रीसहितका अधिकृत २०५६ असार ३ मा नियुक्त भएका थिए । भट्टराईले सोही वर्षको मंसिर १४ गतेको नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका थिए । उनले पछि अदालतबाट समान भर्ना मिति कायम गराए । त्यसैले अब उक्त व्याचबाट जो पहिला एआईजी हुन्छ, उही आईजीपीको लाइनमा रहने भएको हो । प्रहरीमा यसअघि एउटै सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका अधिकृतमध्ये तीनजनासम्म आईजीपी भएको इतिहास छ । २०५१ सालको प्रहरी निरीक्षक दर्जाको आवेदनमा सहभागी भई सोही वर्षको चैत ५ मा नियुक्त भएकामध्ये वसन्तबहादुर कुँवर आईजीपी भएका थिए । सोही व्याचको छनौटअन्तर्गत उत्तीर्ण भई २०५२ भदौ १९ को नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका दीपक थापा र कात्तिक २७ मा नियुक्त चन्द्रकुवेर खापुङ आईजीपी भएका थिए । त्यसपछिको आईजीपी हुने पालो २०५८ सालको टोलीले पाउने छ । उनीहरू २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए । ११२ औँ टोलीबाट डीआईजी बन्ने अधिकृतपछि उनीहरू डीआईजीको लाइनमा छिर्छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताले भावी आईजीपी निर्धारण गर्ने विश्वास गरिन्छ । हाल एसएसपीको वरिष्ठताअनुसार रमेश थापा अगाडि छन् । उक्त ब्याचका अन्य एसएसपीमा क्रमशः अजय केसी, अनुपमसमशेर जबरा, वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, नवराज अधिकारी, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, होबिन्द्र बोगटी, कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी, गोबिन्द अधिकारी, विनोद सिलवाल, श्यामकुमार महतो, बेद विष्ट, शिवकुमार श्रेष्ठ, प्रकाश मल्ल, शान्तिराज कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, रञ्जु सिग्देल, सन्तोष खड्का, सन्तोषकुमार भट्टराई, राजेन्द्रप्रसाद धमला, सन्तोषसिंह राठौर, सञ्जयसिंह थापा, विमलराज कँडेल, महेन्द्र खड्का र प्रभुप्रसाद ढकाल हुन् । यी एसएसपीमध्ये वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, श्यामकुमार महतो र सन्तोषसिंह राठौर २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् । कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी र सन्तोष खड्काको अवकाश २०८५ कात्तिक १ मा हुन्छ । पतिभन्दा पत्नी सिनियर, को होला पहिला डीआईजी ? ११२ औँ टोलीकी अधिकृत तथा हाल एसएसपी दर्जामा रहेकी तारादेवी थापा पुस ५ पछि डीआईजी बढुवाकी एक दाबेदार हुन् । उनको जुनियर टोली, अर्थात् २०५८ साउन १८ का इन्स्पेक्टर टोलीमा पति रमेश थापा छन् । तारादेवी २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवा भएकी हुन् । रमेश भने २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए । पति भावी प्रहरी नेतृत्वका रूपमा चिनिन्छन् । पत्नीलाई भने डीआईजी बढुवा हुनै सकस देखिन्छ । उनी एसएसपी बढुवामा १४ नम्बरमा थिइन् । अब रिक्त हुने ६ जना डीआईजी बढुवाका दाबेदारमध्ये आठौँ नम्बरकी प्रतिस्पर्धी हुन् । उनीभन्दा अगाडि महिला एसएसपीमा गंगा पन्त रहेकी छन् । यदि तारादेवी अहिलेको बढुवामा छुटिन् भने आफूभन्दा जुनियर पतिसँगै उक्त दर्जामा बढुवा हुनुपर्ने अवस्था छ । विगतका प्रहरी बढुवामा भावी नेतृत्वको सम्भावना भएका अधिकृतहरू सिनियर ब्याचलाई उछिनेर अगाडि बढ्ने गरेका घटना छन् । तारादेवी बढुवा भएर पनि आईजीपी नबन्ने, तर रमेश थापाले बढुवामा फड्को मार्नुसँग भावी आईजीको लाइनमा रहने कुरा सम्बन्धित छ । Kathmandu. The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire. Those retiring are Siddhi Bikram Shah, Sushil Singh Rathore, Madhav Prasad Shrestha, Dambar Bahadur BK and Uma Prasad Chaturvedi. They were recruited on Poush 5, 2053. The current head of the Investigation Department, Tekendra Karki, is also an officer of the same recruitment date. Despite the same recruitment date, DIG of Police Binod Kumar Ghimire is retiring in Mangsir due to age limit. Along with that, 6 DIGs will retire by Poush 5. The DIGs who will retire are Om Bahadur Rana Magar, Surendra Bahadur Gurung, Himalaya Kumar Shrestha, Bimal Basnet and Dilip Singh Deuba. Thus, there are eight contenders for the DIG promotion that will take place after the retirement of six DIGs. Somendr Singh Rathore is the first to be promoted to DIG according to the seniority of the SSP promotion on 24 Baisakh 2080. SSPs 1 to 6 of the said SSP promotion have already become DIGs. According to the seniority of the said promotion, now along with Rathore, Mukunda Marasini, Deepshamsher Jabra, Gopal Chandra Bhattarai, Prabin Pokharel, Ganga Pant, Krishna Bahadur Palli Magar, Taradevi Thapa and Prajwal Marahajan are the contenders for the DIG post. One batch, two IGs The 112th team is also getting a chance to create history by having two IGs from one batch in Nepal Police. Before Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, who has been given the responsibility of IG, Dan Bahadur Karki of the same batch had already been IG. Narayan Dutta Poudel, an officer of the same batch, is the Armed IGP. With the seniority of DIG promotion being maintained in the AIG promotion from the 112th batch, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai will become the 35th and 36th IGPs respectively. They are officers who were recruited based on the same date of notification, but have different dates based on their appointment letters. The officers including Khatri were appointed on Asad 3, 2056 BS. Bhattarai received his appointment letter on Mangsir 14 of the same year. Accordingly, if Khatri becomes IG by Asad 3, 2086, Bhattarai will take over the responsibility of the 36th IGP for five months after his retirement. There is a history of up to three IGPs among the officers recruited on the basis of a single notification in the police. Among those who participated in the application for the rank of Police Inspector in 2051 BS and were appointed on Chaitra 5 of the same year, Basanta Bahadur Kunwar became IGP. Deepak Thapa, who passed the selection of the same batch and received the appointment letter on Bhadra 19, 2052 BS, and Chandrakuber Khapung, who was appointed on Kartik 27, became IGP. The 112th team is also getting a similar opportunity. If this happens, the 2058 BS team will get the turn to become the 37th IGP of the police. They were promoted to SSP in 2081 Magh. After the officers from the 112th team become DIGs, they will enter the DIG line. It is believed that the seniority of the promotion will determine the future IGP. Currently, Ramesh Thapa is ahead according to the seniority of the SSP. The other SSPs of the batch are Ajay KC, Anupam Shumsher Jabra, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Nawaraj Adhikari, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Hobindra Bogati, Krishna Prasad Pangeni, Govinda Adhikari, Binod Silwal, Shyam Kumar Mahato, Bed Bista, Shiva Kumar Shrestha, Prakash Malla, Shanti Raj Koirala, Janardan GC, Ranju Sigdel, Santosh Khadka, Santosh Kumar Bhattarai, Rajendra Prasad Dhamala, Santosh Singh Rathore, Sanjay Singh Thapa, Bimal Raj Kandel, Mahendra Khadka and Prabhu Prasad Dhakal. Among these SSPs, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Janardan GC, Shyam Kumar Mahato and Santosh Singh Rathore will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084. Krishna Prasad Pangeni and Santosh Khadka will retire on Kartik 1, 2085. Wife is senior to husband, who will be the first DIG? Taradevi Thapa, an officer of the 112th team and currently in the rank of SSP, is a contender for promotion to DIG after Poush 5. Her husband Ramesh Thapa is in her junior team, that is, the inspector team of Shrawan 18, 2058. Taradevi was promoted to SSP on Baisakh 24, 2080. Ramesh was promoted to SSP in Magh 2081. The husband is known as the future police leader. The wife seems to be in line for promotion to DIG. She was ranked 14th in the SSP promotion. Now she is the eighth contender among the 6 DIG promotion candidates who will be vacant. Ganga Pant is ahead of her in the women's SSP. If Taradevi is released from the current promotion, she will have to be promoted to the same rank along with her junior husband. There have been cases in past police promotions where officers with potential for future leadership have been promoted ahead of the senior batch. Taradevi will not become IGP even if she is promoted, but Ramesh Thapa's leap in promotion is related to the fact that he will be in line for the future IG.

The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire. Those retiring are Siddhi Bikram Shah, Sushil Singh Rathore, Madhav Prasad Shrestha, Dambar Bahadur BK and Uma Prasad Chaturvedi. They were recruited on Poush 5, 2053. The current head of the Investigation Department, Tekendra Karki, is also an officer of the same recruitment date. Despite the same recruitment date, DIG of Police Binod Kumar Ghimire is retiring in Mangsir due to age limit. Along with that, 6 DIGs will retire by Poush 5. The DIGs who will retire are Om Bahadur Rana Magar, Surendra Bahadur Gurung, Himalaya Kumar Shrestha, Bimal Basnet and Dilip Singh Deuba. Thus, there are eight contenders for the DIG promotion that will take place after the retirement of six DIGs. Somendr Singh Rathore is the first to be promoted to DIG according to the seniority of the SSP promotion on 24 Baisakh 2080. SSPs 1 to 6 of the said SSP promotion have already become DIGs. According to the seniority of the said promotion, now along with Rathore, Mukunda Marasini, Deepshamsher Jabra, Gopal Chandra Bhattarai, Prabin Pokharel, Ganga Pant, Krishna Bahadur Palli Magar, Taradevi Thapa and Prajwal Marahajan are the contenders for the DIG post. One batch, two IGs The 112th team is also getting a chance to create history by having two IGs from one batch in Nepal Police. Before Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, who has been given the responsibility of IG, Dan Bahadur Karki of the same batch had already been IG. Narayan Dutta Poudel, an officer of the same batch, is the Armed IGP. With the seniority of DIG promotion being maintained in the AIG promotion from the 112th batch, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai will become the 35th and 36th IGPs respectively. They are officers who were recruited based on the same date of notification, but have different dates based on their appointment letters. The officers including Khatri were appointed on Asad 3, 2056 BS. Bhattarai received his appointment letter on Mangsir 14 of the same year. Accordingly, if Khatri becomes IG by Asad 3, 2086, Bhattarai will take over the responsibility of the 36th IGP for five months after his retirement. There is a history of up to three IGPs among the officers recruited on the basis of a single notification in the police. Among those who participated in the application for the rank of Police Inspector in 2051 BS and were appointed on Chaitra 5 of the same year, Basanta Bahadur Kunwar became IGP. Deepak Thapa, who passed the selection of the same batch and received the appointment letter on Bhadra 19, 2052 BS, and Chandrakuber Khapung, who was appointed on Kartik 27, became IGP. The 112th team is also getting a similar opportunity. If this happens, the 2058 BS team will get the turn to become the 37th IGP of the police. They were promoted to SSP in 2081 Magh. After the officers from the 112th team become DIGs, they will enter the DIG line. It is believed that the seniority of the promotion will determine the future IGP. Currently, Ramesh Thapa is ahead according to the seniority of the SSP. The other SSPs of the batch are Ajay KC, Anupam Shumsher Jabra, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Nawaraj Adhikari, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Hobindra Bogati, Krishna Prasad Pangeni, Govinda Adhikari, Binod Silwal, Shyam Kumar Mahato, Bed Bista, Shiva Kumar Shrestha, Prakash Malla, Shanti Raj Koirala, Janardan GC, Ranju Sigdel, Santosh Khadka, Santosh Kumar Bhattarai, Rajendra Prasad Dhamala, Santosh Singh Rathore, Sanjay Singh Thapa, Bimal Raj Kandel, Mahendra Khadka and Prabhu Prasad Dhakal. Among these SSPs, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Janardan GC, Shyam Kumar Mahato and Santosh Singh Rathore will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084. Krishna Prasad Pangeni and Santosh Khadka will retire on Kartik 1, 2085. Wife is senior to husband, who will be the first DIG? Taradevi Thapa, an officer of the 112th team and currently in the rank of SSP, is a contender for promotion to DIG after Poush 5. Her husband Ramesh Thapa is in her junior team, that is, the inspector team of Shrawan 18, 2058. Taradevi was promoted to SSP on Baisakh 24, 2080. Ramesh was promoted to SSP in Magh 2081. The husband is known as the future police leader. The wife seems to be in line for promotion to DIG. She was ranked 14th in the SSP promotion. Now she is the eighth contender among the 6 DIG promotion candidates who will be vacant. Ganga Pant is ahead of her in the women's SSP. If Taradevi is released from the current promotion, she will have to be promoted to the same rank along with her junior husband. There have been cases in past police promotions where officers with potential for future leadership have been promoted ahead of the senior batch. Taradevi will not become IGP even if she is promoted, but Ramesh Thapa's leap in promotion is related to the fact that he will be in line for the future IG.

The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire. Those retiring are Siddhi Bikram Shah, Sushil Singh Rathore, Madhav Prasad Shrestha, Dambar Bahadur BK and Uma Prasad Chaturvedi. They were recruited on Poush 5, 2053. The current head of the Investigation Department, Tekendra Karki, is also an officer of the same recruitment date. Despite the same recruitment date, DIG of Police Binod Kumar Ghimire is retiring in Mangsir due to age limit. Along with that, 6 DIGs will retire by Poush 5. The DIGs who will retire are Om Bahadur Rana Magar, Surendra Bahadur Gurung, Himalaya Kumar Shrestha, Bimal Basnet and Dilip Singh Deuba. Thus, there are eight contenders for the DIG promotion that will take place after the retirement of six DIGs. Somendr Singh Rathore is the first to be promoted to DIG according to the seniority of the SSP promotion on 24 Baisakh 2080. SSPs 1 to 6 of the said SSP promotion have already become DIGs. According to the seniority of the said promotion, now along with Rathore, Mukunda Marasini, Deepshamsher Jabra, Gopal Chandra Bhattarai, Prabin Pokharel, Ganga Pant, Krishna Bahadur Palli Magar, Taradevi Thapa and Prajwal Marahajan are the contenders for the DIG post. One batch, two IGs The 112th team is also getting a chance to create history by having two IGs from one batch in Nepal Police. Before Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, who has been given the responsibility of IG, Dan Bahadur Karki of the same batch had already been IG. Narayan Dutta Poudel, an officer of the same batch, is the Armed IGP. With the seniority of DIG promotion being maintained in the AIG promotion from the 112th batch, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai will become the 35th and 36th IGPs respectively. They are officers who were recruited based on the same date of notification, but have different dates based on their appointment letters. The officers including Khatri were appointed on Asad 3, 2056 BS. Bhattarai received his appointment letter on Mangsir 14 of the same year. Accordingly, if Khatri becomes IG by Asad 3, 2086, Bhattarai will take over the responsibility of the 36th IGP for five months after his retirement. There is a history of up to three IGPs among the officers recruited on the basis of a single notification in the police. Among those who participated in the application for the rank of Police Inspector in 2051 BS and were appointed on Chaitra 5 of the same year, Basanta Bahadur Kunwar became IGP. Deepak Thapa, who passed the selection of the same batch and received the appointment letter on Bhadra 19, 2052 BS, and Chandrakuber Khapung, who was appointed on Kartik 27, became IGP. The 112th team is also getting a similar opportunity. If this happens, the 2058 BS team will get the turn to become the 37th IGP of the police. They were promoted to SSP in 2081 Magh. After the officers from the 112th team become DIGs, they will enter the DIG line. It is believed that the seniority of the promotion will determine the future IGP. Currently, Ramesh Thapa is ahead according to the seniority of the SSP. The other SSPs of the batch are Ajay KC, Anupam Shumsher Jabra, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Nawaraj Adhikari, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Hobindra Bogati, Krishna Prasad Pangeni, Govinda Adhikari, Binod Silwal, Shyam Kumar Mahato, Bed Bista, Shiva Kumar Shrestha, Prakash Malla, Shanti Raj Koirala, Janardan GC, Ranju Sigdel, Santosh Khadka, Santosh Kumar Bhattarai, Rajendra Prasad Dhamala, Santosh Singh Rathore, Sanjay Singh Thapa, Bimal Raj Kandel, Mahendra Khadka and Prabhu Prasad Dhakal. Among these SSPs, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Janardan GC, Shyam Kumar Mahato and Santosh Singh Rathore will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084. Krishna Prasad Pangeni and Santosh Khadka will retire on Kartik 1, 2085. Wife is senior to husband, who will be the first DIG? Taradevi Thapa, an officer of the 112th team and currently in the rank of SSP, is a contender for promotion to DIG after Poush 5. Her husband Ramesh Thapa is in her junior team, that is, the inspector team of Shrawan 18, 2058. Taradevi was promoted to SSP on Baisakh 24, 2080. Ramesh was promoted to SSP in Magh 2081. The husband is known as the future police leader. The wife seems to be in line for promotion to DIG. She was ranked 14th in the SSP promotion. Now she is the eighth contender among the 6 DIG promotion candidates who will be vacant. Ganga Pant is ahead of her in the women's SSP. If Taradevi is released from the current promotion, she will have to be promoted to the same rank along with her junior husband. There have been cases in past police promotions where officers with potential for future leadership have been promoted ahead of the senior batch. Taradevi will not become IGP even if she is promoted, but Ramesh Thapa's leap in promotion is related to the fact that he will be in line for the future IG.

The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire. Those retiring are Siddhi Bikram Shah, Sushil Singh Rathore, Madhav Prasad Shrestha, Dambar Bahadur BK and Uma Prasad Chaturvedi. They were recruited on Poush 5, 2053. The current head of the Investigation Department, Tekendra Karki, is also an officer of the same recruitment date. Despite the same recruitment date, DIG of Police Binod Kumar Ghimire is retiring in Mangsir due to age limit. Along with that, 6 DIGs will retire by Poush 5. The DIGs who will retire are Om Bahadur Rana Magar, Surendra Bahadur Gurung, Himalaya Kumar Shrestha, Bimal Basnet and Dilip Singh Deuba. Thus, there are eight contenders for the DIG promotion that will take place after the retirement of six DIGs. Somendr Singh Rathore is the first to be promoted to DIG according to the seniority of the SSP promotion on 24 Baisakh 2080. SSPs 1 to 6 of the said SSP promotion have already become DIGs. According to the seniority of the said promotion, now along with Rathore, Mukunda Marasini, Deepshamsher Jabra, Gopal Chandra Bhattarai, Prabin Pokharel, Ganga Pant, Krishna Bahadur Palli Magar, Taradevi Thapa and Prajwal Marahajan are the contenders for the DIG post. One batch, two IGs The 112th team is also getting a chance to create history by having two IGs from one batch in Nepal Police. Before Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, who has been given the responsibility of IG, Dan Bahadur Karki of the same batch had already been IG. Narayan Dutta Poudel, an officer of the same batch, is the Armed IGP. With the seniority of DIG promotion being maintained in the AIG promotion from the 112th batch, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai will become the 35th and 36th IGPs respectively. They are officers who were recruited based on the same date of notification, but have different dates based on their appointment letters. The officers including Khatri were appointed on Asad 3, 2056 BS. Bhattarai received his appointment letter on Mangsir 14 of the same year. Accordingly, if Khatri becomes IG by Asad 3, 2086, Bhattarai will take over the responsibility of the 36th IGP for five months after his retirement. There is a history of up to three IGPs among the officers recruited on the basis of a single notification in the police. Among those who participated in the application for the rank of Police Inspector in 2051 BS and were appointed on Chaitra 5 of the same year, Basanta Bahadur Kunwar became IGP. Deepak Thapa, who passed the selection of the same batch and received the appointment letter on Bhadra 19, 2052 BS, and Chandrakuber Khapung, who was appointed on Kartik 27, became IGP. The 112th team is also getting a similar opportunity. If this happens, the 2058 BS team will get the turn to become the 37th IGP of the police. They were promoted to SSP in 2081 Magh. After the officers from the 112th team become DIGs, they will enter the DIG line. It is believed that the seniority of the promotion will determine the future IGP. Currently, Ramesh Thapa is ahead according to the seniority of the SSP. The other SSPs of the batch are Ajay KC, Anupam Shumsher Jabra, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Nawaraj Adhikari, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Hobindra Bogati, Krishna Prasad Pangeni, Govinda Adhikari, Binod Silwal, Shyam Kumar Mahato, Bed Bista, Shiva Kumar Shrestha, Prakash Malla, Shanti Raj Koirala, Janardan GC, Ranju Sigdel, Santosh Khadka, Santosh Kumar Bhattarai, Rajendra Prasad Dhamala, Santosh Singh Rathore, Sanjay Singh Thapa, Bimal Raj Kandel, Mahendra Khadka and Prabhu Prasad Dhakal. Among these SSPs, Bir Bahadur Budhamagar, Krishna Prasad Koirala, Janardan GC, Shyam Kumar Mahato and Santosh Singh Rathore will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084. Krishna Prasad Pangeni and Santosh Khadka will retire on Kartik 1, 2085. Wife is senior to husband, who will be the first DIG? Taradevi Thapa, an officer of the 112th team and currently in the rank of SSP, is a contender for promotion to DIG after Poush 5. Her husband Ramesh Thapa is in her junior team, that is, the inspector team of Shrawan 18, 2058. Taradevi was promoted to SSP on Baisakh 24, 2080. Ramesh was promoted to SSP in Magh 2081. The husband is known as the future police leader. The wife seems to be in line for promotion to DIG. She was ranked 14th in the SSP promotion. Now she is the eighth contender among the 6 DIG promotion candidates who will be vacant. Ganga Pant is ahead of her in the women's SSP. If Taradevi is released from the current promotion, she will have to be promoted to the same rank along with her junior husband. There have been cases in past police promotions where officers with potential for future leadership have been promoted ahead of the senior batch. Taradevi will not become IGP even if she is promoted, but Ramesh Thapa's leap in promotion is related to the fact that he will be in line for the future IG.

डीआईजीमा बढुवा भएका थिए । ११२ औँ टोलीका डीआईजीमध्ये खत्री र भट्टराईपछि बढुवाको वरिष्ठतामा क्रमशः ओमप्रसाद अधिकारी, शेखर खनाल, अविनारायण काफ्ले र विश्व अधिकारी छन् । यसमध्ये काफ्लेले यसपटक एआईजी पदको रिक्ततापछि बढुवा पाएनन् भने डीआईजीबाटै अवकाश हुनुपर्ने सम्भावना छ । उनी ३० वर्षे सेवा अवधिका कारण २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् । एआईजी बढुवा छनौटमुखी हुने हो भने भावी नेतृत्वमा अगाडि बढाइने दीपेन्द्रबहादुर घर्ती क्षेत्री, उनीपछि भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री, सानुराम भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । तर, १११ औँ टोलीलाई मात्रै प्राथमिकता दिइयो भने न घर्ती, न त खत्री र भट्टराई नै अहिले एआईजी हुन्छन् । त्यसैले सरकारले करिअरलाई हेर्छ कि पूर्वबढुवाको वरिष्ठता ? यो प्रतीक्षाको विषय हो । यदि एआईजीको लाइनमा राखियो भने हालका आईजीपी डा.केसीपछि ४५ दिनका लागि घर्ती र उनीपछि खत्री, भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । यदि घर्ती आईजीपी बनाइएनन् भने एउटै कारणले नबन्न सक्छन्, ‘नमस्ते टोली’ का नाममा । प्रहरीभित्र ‘नमस्ते’ भनिने राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट समायोजन भएका अधिकृतप्रति नकारात्मक व्यहार हुँदै आएको छ । घर्ती २०५५ जेठ १० मा सोही विभागमा भर्ना भएका थिए । यद्यपि, ११२ औँ टोलीबाट दुई जना एआईजी पाउने कि नपाउने भन्ने कुरा हाल सर्वोच्च अदालतमा निवर्तमान आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्कीले दायर गरेको रिटमाथिको आदेशमा निर्भर रहन्छ । कार्कीले आफूलाई पदबाट हटाइएको निर्णय बदर गर्ने मागसहित सर्वोच्च अदालतमा रिट दायर गरेका हुन् । यदि कार्की पदमा फर्किए भने एआईजीको रिक्त संख्या ५ मात्रै हुन्छ । पुस ५ गते राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट सेवा प्रवेश गरेका ५ एआईजी अवकाश हुन लागेका हुन् । अवकाश हुनेमा सिद्धीविक्रम शाह, सुशीलसिंह राठौर, माधवप्रसाद श्रेष्ठ, डम्बरबहादुर विक र उमाप्रसाद चतुर्वेदी छन् । उनीहरू २०५३ पुस ५ मा भर्ना भएका थिए । अनुसन्धान विभागका वर्तमान प्रमुख टेकेन्द्र कार्की पनि सोही भर्ना मितिका अधिकृत हुन् । सोही भर्ना मिति भए पनि उमेर हदका कारण प्रहरीका डीआईजी विनोदकुमार घिमिरे मंसिरमै अवकाश हुँदैछन् । त्यससँगै पुस ५ सम्ममा ६ जना डीआईजी अवकाश हुन्छन् । अवकाश हुने डीआईजीमा ओमबहादुर राना मगर, सुरेन्द्रबहादुर गुरुङ, हिमालयकुमार श्रेष्ठ, विमल बस्नेत र दिलीपसिंह देउवा हुन् । यसरी ६ जना डीआईजीको अवकाशपछि हुने डीआईजी बढुवाका निम्ति आठजना प्रतिस्पर्धी छन् । २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार डीआईजी हुने पहिलो नम्बरमा सोमेन्द्रसिंह राठौर छन् । उक्त एसएसपी बढुवाका १ देखि ६ नम्बरसम्मका एसएसपी डीआईजी भइसकेका छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार अब क्रमशः राठौरसहित मुकुन्द मरासिनी, दीपशम्शेर जबरा, गोपाल चन्द्र भट्टराई, प्रवीण पोखरेल, गंगा पन्त, कृष्णबहादुर पल्ली मगर, तारादेवी थापा र प्रज्वल मर्हजन डीआईजीका दाबेदार हुन् । एक ब्याच, दुई आईजीको सम्भावना टर्‍यो नेपाल प्रहरीमा एक व्याचबाट दुई आईजीको इतिहास रच्ने मौका ११२ औँ टोलीले पनि पाउने थियो । तर, नियुक्तिपत्र प्राप्त मितिलाई अदालतमार्फत संशोधन गराएपछि त्यस्तो सम्भावना टरेको छ । हाल आईजीको जिम्मेवारी पाएका डा.मनोजकुमार केसीअघि सोही ब्याचका दानबहादुर कार्की आईजी भइसकेका छन् । सोही ब्याचका अधिकृत नारायणदत्त पौडेल सशस्त्र आईजीपी छन् । ११२ औँ टोलीबाट अहिले एआईजी बढुवामा डीआईजी बढुवाको वरिष्ठता कायम हुँदा क्रमशः भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री र सानुराम भट्टराई क्रमशः ३५ औँ र ३६ औँ आईजीपी बन्ने सम्भावना थियो । उनीहरू एउटै मितिको सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका, तर नियुक्तिपत्रका आधारमा फरक मिति भएका अधिकृत हुन् । खत्रीसहितका अधिकृत २०५६ असार ३ मा नियुक्त भएका थिए । भट्टराईले सोही वर्षको मंसिर १४ गतेको नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका थिए । उनले पछि अदालतबाट समान भर्ना मिति कायम गराए । त्यसैले अब उक्त व्याचबाट जो पहिला एआईजी हुन्छ, उही आईजीपीको लाइनमा रहने भएको हो । प्रहरीमा यसअघि एउटै सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका अधिकृतमध्ये तीनजनासम्म आईजीपी भएको इतिहास छ । २०५१ सालको प्रहरी निरीक्षक दर्जाको आवेदनमा सहभागी भई सोही वर्षको चैत ५ मा नियुक्त भएकामध्ये वसन्तबहादुर कुँवर आईजीपी भएका थिए । सोही व्याचको छनौटअन्तर्गत उत्तीर्ण भई २०५२ भदौ १९ को नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका दीपक थापा र कात्तिक २७ मा नियुक्त चन्द्रकुवेर खापुङ आईजीपी भएका थिए । त्यसपछिको आईजीपी हुने पालो २०५८ सालको टोलीले पाउने छ । उनीहरू २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए । ११२ औँ टोलीबाट डीआईजी बन्ने अधिकृतपछि उनीहरू डीआईजीको लाइनमा छिर्छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताले भावी आईजीपी निर्धारण गर्ने विश्वास गरिन्छ । हाल एसएसपीको वरिष्ठताअनुसार रमेश थापा अगाडि छन् । उक्त ब्याचका अन्य एसएसपीमा क्रमशः अजय केसी, अनुपमसमशेर जबरा, वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, नवराज अधिकारी, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, होबिन्द्र बोगटी, कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी, गोबिन्द अधिकारी, विनोद सिलवाल, श्यामकुमार महतो, बेद विष्ट, शिवकुमार श्रेष्ठ, प्रकाश मल्ल, शान्तिराज कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, रञ्जु सिग्देल, सन्तोष खड्का, सन्तोषकुमार भट्टराई, राजेन्द्रप्रसाद धमला, सन्तोषसिंह राठौर, सञ्जयसिंह थापा, विमलराज कँडेल, महेन्द्र खड्का र प्रभुप्रसाद ढकाल हुन् । यी एसएसपीमध्ये वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, श्यामकुमार महतो र सन्तोषसिंह राठौर २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् । कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी र सन्तोष खड्काको अवकाश २०८५ कात्तिक १ मा हुन्छ । पतिभन्दा पत्नी सिनियर, को होला पहिला डीआईजी ? ११२ औँ टोलीकी अधिकृत तथा हाल एसएसपी दर्जामा रहेकी तारादेवी थापा पुस ५ पछि डीआईजी बढुवाकी एक दाबेदार हुन् । उनको जुनियर टोली, अर्थात् २०५८ साउन १८ का इन्स्पेक्टर टोलीमा पति रमेश थापा छन् । तारादेवी २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवा भएकी हुन् । रमेश भने २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए । पति भावी प्रहरी नेतृत्वका रूपमा चिनिन्छन् । पत्नीलाई भने डीआईजी बढुवा हुनै सकस देखिन्छ । उनी एसएसपी बढुवामा १४ नम्बरमा थिइन् । अब रिक्त हुने ६ जना डीआईजी बढुवाका दाबेदारमध्ये आठौँ नम्बरकी प्रतिस्पर्धी हुन् । उनीभन्दा अगाडि महिला एसएसपीमा गंगा पन्त रहेकी छन् । यदि तारादेवी अहिलेको बढुवामा छुटिन् भने आफूभन्दा जुनियर पतिसँगै उक्त दर्जामा बढुवा हुनुपर्ने अवस्था छ । विगतका प्रहरी बढुवामा भावी नेतृत्वको सम्भावना भएका अधिकृतहरू सिनियर ब्याचलाई उछिनेर अगाडि बढ्ने गरेका घटना छन् । तारादेवी बढुवा भएर पनि आईजीपी नबन्ने, तर रमेश थापाले बढुवामा फड्को मार्नुसँग भावी आईजीको लाइनमा रहने कुरा सम्बन्धित छ । Kathmandu. The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire. Those retiring are Siddhi Bikram Shah, Sushil Singh Rathore, Madhav Prasad Shrestha, Dambar Bahadur BK and Uma Prasad Chaturvedi. They were recruited on Poush 5, 2053. The current head of the Investigation Department, Tekendra Karki, is also an officer of the same recruitment date. Despite the same recruitment date, DIG of Police Binod Kumar Ghimire is retiring in Mangsir due to age limit. Along with that, 6 DIGs will retire by Poush 5. The DIGs who will retire are Om Bahadur Rana Magar, Surendra Bahadur Gurung, Himalaya Kumar Shrestha, Bimal Basnet and Dilip Singh Deuba. Thus, there are eight contenders for the DIG promotion that will take place after the retirement of six DIGs. Somendr Singh Rathore is the first to be promoted to DIG according to the seniority of the SSP promotion on 24 Baisakh 2080. SSPs 1 to 6 of the said SSP promotion have already become DIGs. According to the seniority of the said promotion, now along with Rathore, Mukunda Marasini, Deepshamsher Jabra, Gopal Chandra Bhattarai, Prabin Pokharel, Ganga Pant, Krishna Bahadur Palli Magar, Taradevi Thapa and Prajwal Marahajan are the contenders for the DIG post. One batch, two IGs The 112th team is also getting a chance to create history by having two IGs from one batch in Nepal Police. Before Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, who has been given the responsibility of IG, Dan Bahadur Karki of the same batch had already been IG. Narayan Dutta Poudel, an officer of the same batch, is the Armed IGP. With the seniority of DIG promotion being maintained in the AIG promotion from the 112th batch, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai will become the 35th and 36th IGPs respectively. They are officers who were recruited based on the same date of notification, but have different dates based on their appointment letters. The officers including Khatri were appointed on Asad 3, 2056 BS. Bhattarai received his appointment letter on Mangsir 14 of the same year. Accordingly, if Khatri becomes IG by Asad 3, 2086, Bhattarai will take over the responsibility of the 36th IGP for five months after his retirement. There is a history of up to three IGPs among the officers recruited on the basis of a single notification in the police. Among those who participated in the application for the rank of Police Inspector in 2051 BS and were appointed on Chaitra 5 of the same year, Basanta Bahadur Kunwar became IGP. Deepak Thapa, who passed the selection of the same batch and received the appointment letter on Bhadra 19, 2052 BS, and Chandrakuber Khapung, who was appointed on Kartik 27, became IGP. The 112th team is also getting a similar opportunity. If this happens, the 2058 BS team will get the turn to become the 37th IGP of the police. They were promoted to SSP in 2081 Magh. After the officers from the 112th team become DIGs, they will enter the DIG line. It is believed that the seniority of the promotion will determine the future IGP. आईजीपी नबन्ने, तर रमेश थापाले बढुवामा फड्को मार्नुसँग भावी आईजीको लाइनमा रहने कुरा सम्बन्धित छ ।

काठमाडौं । अब एक महिनाभित्र नेपाल प्रहरीमा बढुवाको रस्साकस्सी शुरु हुँदैछ । त्यसक्रममा एउटै ब्याच दुई आईजी हुनेदेखि सिनियर पत्नीलाई जुनियर पतिले उछिन्नेसम्मका सन्दर्भ प्रहरीभित्र चर्चामा छ ।

प्रहरी महानिरीक्षकबाट दानबहादुर कार्की प्रधानमन्त्रीको सुरक्षा सल्लाहकारमा सरुवा र डा.मनोजकुमार केसी उक्त पदमा नियुक्त भएसँगै नेपाल प्रहरीमा एउटा एआईजी पद रिक्त भइसकेको छ । पुस ५ गते थप पाँच एआईजी अवकाशपछि रिक्त एआईजीको संख्या ६ पुग्दैछ ।

प्रहरी संगठनको सर्वोच्च पद महानिरीक्षक (आईजीपी) का भावी दाबेदार निर्धारण हुने गरी एआईजी बढुवाको तयारीमा सरकार जुटेको छ । २०८४ चैत १८ सम्म पदावधि कायम रहेका वर्तमान आईजीपी डा.केसी र उनको ब्याच १११ औँ टोलीका अधिकृत एकै साथ अवकाश हुँदा संगठनको नेतृत्व गर्नका निम्ति ११२ औँ टोलीबाट नयाँ आईजीपी चयन हुन्छन् ।

२०८२ कात्तिक १७ गतेको डीआईजी बढुवाको वरिष्ठता कायमै भएमा उक्त व्याचबाट भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री र सानुराम भट्टराई पुस ५ पछि एआईजीका दाबेदार हुन् । तर, उनीहरूसँगै १११ औँ टोलीबाट एआईजी हुन बाँकी रहेका चारजना डीआईजीले पुस ५ पछि रिक्त हुने एआईजी बढुवामा मौका पाउँदैछन् । त्यस्ता डीआईजीमा राजेन्द्रप्रसाद भट्ट, दिनेशकुमार आचार्य, अरुण पौडेल, गोविन्द थपलिया, सुदर्शनप्रसाद कोइराला र दीपक रेग्मी पर्छन् । उनीहरू २०८१ पुसमा एसएसपीबाट डीआईजीमा बढुवा भएका थिए ।

११२ औँ टोलीका डीआईजीमध्ये खत्री र भट्टराईपछि बढुवाको वरिष्ठतामा क्रमशः ओमप्रसाद अधिकारी, शेखर खनाल, अविनारायण काफ्ले र विश्व अधिकारी छन् । यसमध्ये काफ्लेले यसपटक एआईजी पदको रिक्ततापछि बढुवा पाएनन् भने डीआईजीबाटै अवकाश हुनुपर्ने सम्भावना छ । उनी ३० वर्षे सेवा अवधिका कारण २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् ।

एआईजी बढुवा छनौटमुखी हुने हो भने भावी नेतृत्वमा अगाडि बढाइने दीपेन्द्रबहादुर घर्ती क्षेत्री, उनीपछि भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री, सानुराम भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । तर, १११ औँ टोलीलाई मात्रै प्राथमिकता दिइयो भने न घर्ती, न त खत्री र भट्टराई नै अहिले एआईजी हुन्छन् । त्यसैले सरकारले करिअरलाई हेर्छ कि पूर्वबढुवाको वरिष्ठता ? यो प्रतीक्षाको विषय हो ।

यदि एआईजीको लाइनमा राखियो भने हालका आईजीपी डा.केसीपछि ४५ दिनका लागि घर्ती र उनीपछि खत्री, भट्टराईहरुको पालो आउँछ । यदि घर्ती आईजीपी बनाइएनन् भने एउटै कारणले नबन्न सक्छन्, ‘नमस्ते टोली’ का नाममा । प्रहरीभित्र ‘नमस्ते’ भनिने राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट समायोजन भएका अधिकृतप्रति नकारात्मक व्यहार हुँदै आएको छ । घर्ती २०५५ जेठ १० मा सोही विभागमा भर्ना भएका थिए ।

यद्यपि, ११२ औँ टोलीबाट दुई जना एआईजी पाउने कि नपाउने भन्ने कुरा हाल सर्वोच्च अदालतमा निवर्तमान आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्कीले दायर गरेको रिटमाथिको आदेशमा निर्भर रहन्छ । कार्कीले आफूलाई पदबाट हटाइएको निर्णय बदर गर्ने मागसहित सर्वोच्च अदालतमा रिट दायर गरेका हुन् । यदि कार्की पदमा फर्किए भने एआईजीको रिक्त संख्या ५ मात्रै हुन्छ ।

पुस ५ गते राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभागबाट सेवा प्रवेश गरेका ५ एआईजी अवकाश हुन लागेका हुन् । अवकाश हुनेमा सिद्धीविक्रम शाह, सुशीलसिंह राठौर, माधवप्रसाद श्रेष्ठ, डम्बरबहादुर विक र उमाप्रसाद चतुर्वेदी छन् । उनीहरू २०५३ पुस ५ मा भर्ना भएका थिए । अनुसन्धान विभागका वर्तमान प्रमुख टेकेन्द्र कार्की पनि सोही भर्ना मितिका अधिकृत हुन् ।

सोही भर्ना मिति भए पनि उमेर हदका कारण प्रहरीका डीआईजी विनोदकुमार घिमिरे मंसिरमै अवकाश हुँदैछन् । त्यससँगै पुस ५ सम्ममा ६ जना डीआईजी अवकाश हुन्छन् । अवकाश हुने डीआईजीमा ओमबहादुर राना मगर, सुरेन्द्रबहादुर गुरुङ, हिमालयकुमार श्रेष्ठ, विमल बस्नेत र दिलीपसिंह देउवा हुन् ।

यसरी ६ जना डीआईजीको अवकाशपछि हुने डीआईजी बढुवाका निम्ति आठजना प्रतिस्पर्धी छन् । २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार डीआईजी हुने पहिलो नम्बरमा सोमेन्द्रसिंह राठौर छन् । उक्त एसएसपी बढुवाका १ देखि ६ नम्बरसम्मका एसएसपी डीआईजी भइसकेका छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताअनुसार अब क्रमशः राठौरसहित मुकुन्द मरासिनी, दीपशम्शेर जबरा, गोपाल चन्द्र भट्टराई, प्रवीण पोखरेल, गंगा पन्त, कृष्णबहादुर पल्ली मगर, तारादेवी थापा र प्रज्वल मर्हजन डीआईजीका दाबेदार हुन् ।

एक ब्याच, दुई आईजीको सम्भावना टर्‍यो

नेपाल प्रहरीमा एक व्याचबाट दुई आईजीको इतिहास रच्ने मौका ११२ औँ टोलीले पनि पाउने थियो । तर, नियुक्तिपत्र प्राप्त मितिलाई अदालतमार्फत संशोधन गराएपछि त्यस्तो सम्भावना टरेको छ । हाल आईजीको जिम्मेवारी पाएका डा.मनोजकुमार केसीअघि सोही ब्याचका दानबहादुर कार्की आईजी भइसकेका छन् । सोही ब्याचका अधिकृत नारायणदत्त पौडेल सशस्त्र आईजीपी छन् ।

११२ औँ टोलीबाट अहिले एआईजी बढुवामा डीआईजी बढुवाको वरिष्ठता कायम हुँदा क्रमशः भूपेन्द्रबहादुर खत्री र सानुराम भट्टराई क्रमशः ३५ औँ र ३६ औँ आईजीपी बन्ने सम्भावना थियो । उनीहरू एउटै मितिको सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका, तर नियुक्तिपत्रका आधारमा फरक मिति भएका अधिकृत हुन् । खत्रीसहितका अधिकृत २०५६ असार ३ मा नियुक्त भएका थिए । भट्टराईले सोही वर्षको मंसिर १४ गतेको नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका थिए । उनले पछि अदालतबाट समान भर्ना मिति कायम गराए । त्यसैले अब उक्त व्याचबाट जो पहिला एआईजी हुन्छ, उही आईजीपीको लाइनमा रहने भएको हो ।

प्रहरीमा यसअघि एउटै सूचनाका आधारमा भर्ना भएका अधिकृतमध्ये तीनजनासम्म आईजीपी भएको इतिहास छ ।

२०५१ सालको प्रहरी निरीक्षक दर्जाको आवेदनमा सहभागी भई सोही वर्षको चैत ५ मा नियुक्त भएकामध्ये वसन्तबहादुर कुँवर आईजीपी भएका थिए । सोही व्याचको छनौटअन्तर्गत उत्तीर्ण भई २०५२ भदौ १९ को नियुक्तिपत्र पाएका दीपक थापा र कात्तिक २७ मा नियुक्त चन्द्रकुवेर खापुङ आईजीपी भएका थिए ।

त्यसपछिको आईजीपी हुने पालो २०५८ सालको टोलीले पाउने छ । उनीहरू २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए । ११२ औँ टोलीबाट डीआईजी बन्ने अधिकृतपछि उनीहरू डीआईजीको लाइनमा छिर्छन् । उक्त बढुवाको वरिष्ठताले भावी आईजीपी निर्धारण गर्ने विश्वास गरिन्छ । हाल एसएसपीको वरिष्ठताअनुसार रमेश थापा अगाडि छन् ।

उक्त ब्याचका अन्य एसएसपीमा क्रमशः अजय केसी, अनुपमसमशेर जबरा, वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, नवराज अधिकारी, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, होबिन्द्र बोगटी, कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी, गोबिन्द अधिकारी, विनोद सिलवाल, श्यामकुमार महतो, बेद विष्ट, शिवकुमार श्रेष्ठ, प्रकाश मल्ल, शान्तिराज कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, रञ्जु सिग्देल, सन्तोष खड्का, सन्तोषकुमार भट्टराई, राजेन्द्रप्रसाद धमला, सन्तोषसिंह राठौर, सञ्जयसिंह थापा, विमलराज कँडेल, महेन्द्र खड्का र प्रभुप्रसाद ढकाल हुन् ।

यी एसएसपीमध्ये वीरबहादुर बुढामगर, कृष्णप्रसाद कोइराला, जनार्दन जीसी, श्यामकुमार महतो र सन्तोषसिंह राठौर २०८४ चैत १६ मा अवकाश हुन्छन् । कृष्णप्रसाद पंगेनी र सन्तोष खड्काको अवकाश २०८५ कात्तिक १ मा हुन्छ ।

पतिभन्दा पत्नी सिनियर, को होला पहिला डीआईजी ?

११२ औँ टोलीकी अधिकृत तथा हाल एसएसपी दर्जामा रहेकी तारादेवी थापा पुस ५ पछि डीआईजी बढुवाकी एक दाबेदार हुन् । उनको जुनियर टोली, अर्थात् २०५८ साउन १८ का इन्स्पेक्टर टोलीमा पति रमेश थापा छन् । तारादेवी २०८० वैशाख २४ मा एसएसपी बढुवा भएकी हुन् । रमेश भने २०८१ माघमा एसएसपी बढुवा भए ।

पति भावी प्रहरी नेतृत्वका रूपमा चिनिन्छन् । पत्नीलाई भने डीआईजी बढुवा हुनै सकस देखिन्छ । उनी एसएसपी बढुवामा १४ नम्बरमा थिइन् । अब रिक्त हुने ६ जना डीआईजी बढुवाका दाबेदारमध्ये आठौँ नम्बरकी प्रतिस्पर्धी हुन् । उनीभन्दा अगाडि महिला एसएसपीमा गंगा पन्त रहेकी छन् ।

यदि तारादेवी अहिलेको बढुवामा छुटिन् भने आफूभन्दा जुनियर पतिसँगै उक्त दर्जामा बढुवा हुनुपर्ने अवस्था छ । विगतका प्रहरी बढुवामा भावी नेतृत्वको सम्भावना भएका अधिकृतहरू सिनियर ब्याचलाई उछिनेर अगाडि बढ्ने गरेका घटना छन् । तारादेवी बढुवा भएर पनि आईजीपी नबन्ने, तर रमेश थापाले बढुवामा फड्को मार्नुसँग भावी आईजीको लाइनमा रहने कुरा सम्बन्धित छ ।

Kathmandu. The Nepal Police promotion race is set to begin within a month. In the process, there are discussions within the police about everything from two IGs in the same batch to a senior wife being surpassed by a junior husband. With the transfer of Dan Bahadur Karki from Inspector General of Police to the Prime Minister's Security Advisor and the appointment of Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to the post, one AIG post has become vacant in the Nepal Police. After the retirement of five more AIGs on Poush 5, the number of vacant AIGs is reaching six. The government is preparing for the AIG promotion to determine the future contenders for the highest post of Inspector General (IGP) of the police organization. When the current IGP Dr. KC, whose term of office is till 18 Chaitra 2084, and his batch of officers from the 111th team retire together, a new IGP will be selected from the 112th team to lead the organization. If the seniority of the DIG promotion on Kartik 17, 2082 remains, Bhupendra Bahadur Khatri and Sanuram Bhattarai from that batch are the contenders for AIG after Poush 5. However, along with them, four DIGs who are yet to become AIGs from the 111th batch are getting a chance to be promoted to AIGs that will become vacant after Poush 5. Such DIGs include Rajendra Prasad Bhatta, Dinesh Kumar Acharya, Arun Poudel and Govinda Thapaliya. They were promoted from SSP to DIG in Poush 5, 2081. Among the DIGs of the 112th team, after Khatri and Bhattarai, Om Prasad Adhikari, Shekhar Khanal, Abinarayan Kafle and Bishwa Adhikari are in seniority in terms of promotion. Among them, if Kafle does not get the promotion this time due to the vacancy of the AIG post, there is a possibility that he will have to retire as a DIG. He will retire on Chaitra 16, 2084, due to his 30-year service period. However, whether or not the 112th team will get two AIGs depends on the verdict on the writ petition filed by outgoing IGP Dan Bahadur Karki in the Supreme Court. Karki has filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court seeking to overturn the decision to remove him from the post. If Karki returns to the post, the vacancy of AIGs will be reduced to only five. Five AIGs who joined the National Investigation Department on Poush 5 are set to retire.
